reviews.review:
Too many little things that just sucks ass x5 

They had a good thing going, should have fine tuned it and make it enjoyable

If there was a way to rate a game with neither yes or no, that is how I would rate this game. 
It has no major issues, it isnt buggy or anything like that, although at times it can have framedrops. However, I do not really enjoy it. 

From a base gameplay perspective it is pretty similar to the old Remnant, however personally I find it a downgrade in most ways. The bosses I fought so far are for the most part just bigger versions of basic enemies or boss rushes, with the exception of the ravager (which I skipped originally) and the cube (from the point where I am in at the game). The level design takes a steep decline in the labyrinth and even the enemies there are boring. Personally I really liked the original games level design, but this doesnt speak to me as much. 

However as I said I can neither fully say its a yes or no game, I like the way replayability works in this game and how exploration is rewarded in the form of areas and secrets, an upgrade to the original is the mulititude of classes and subclasses. However I find the classes somewhat uninteresting and they dont alter gameplay by much. 

I generally just think that there are other games which play in a similar manner and execute the RPG / Souls-like style of gameplay a lot better. Maybe one day I will decide to play it again and the endgame will change my mind, maybe the game is only really enjoyable with a multitude of people, if I do ever change my opinion I will make sure to change this review.
